title: Mushroom and Thyme Gravy
summary: Chestnut mushrooms browned in butter with onion and garlic, thickened with flour and simmered in beef stock with thyme.
equipment: wide saucepan or deep frying pan

ingredients.note: low-salt; contains celery in most brands

ingredients.item: fresh thyme leaves, plus sprigs to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Melt the butter over medium-high heat and add the mushrooms. Cook for 8-10 min, stirring now and then, until their juices have cooked away and they are deeply browned.

steps.title: Add onion and garlic
steps.text: Stir in the onion and garlic and cook for 3 min until softened.

steps.title: Cook the flour
steps.text: Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 min so it coats the mushrooms.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Gradually whisk in the hot stock with the thyme. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 10-12 min until thickened and slightly reduced.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and pepper and spoon over sliced roast chicken, steak or mash. Scatter with a few thyme leaves.

tips: Do not crowd the pan; mushrooms that steam will not brown.
A few dried porcini, soaked in the hot stock, deepen the flavour.
Use a mix of mushrooms such as chestnut and oyster.
Thin with a little water if needed.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat gently until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
